title: HVGERP Local Test Host
limitations: A helper retained the already closed first tab; the replacement tab setup timed out before the helper was rebound. This exploratory setup is retained, not a passing application case.
DOM and trace are sequential, not atomic; duplicate rendered Trace text is omitted when parsed trace is stored.
Focus can add board reads, and readback error remains an honest Saved; detail refresh failed result even when the following assignment hydrates successfully.
